mapper.insert: insert into abr_breaker_trip (rule_id, rule_code, metric, scope, agent_code, metric_value, sample_size, threshold, window_start, action, dedup_key, create_time) values (#{ruleId}, #{ruleCode}, #{metric}, #{scope}, #{agentCode}, #{metricValue}, #{sampleSize}, #{threshold}, #{windowStart}, coalesce(#{action}, ''), #{dedupKey}, now()) on conflict (dedup_key) where dedup_key is not null do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_breaker_trip set resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_time = now() where resolved_time is null and scope = #{scope} and rule_code not like 'budget%' and agent_code = #{agentCode}
